title: refactor: rename fetch_user to load_user across the service
body: Mechanical rename of fetch_user -> load_user ahead of the loader split. No behavior change intended.

files.diff:
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
 
 # Single row -> domain object.
-def fetch_user(uid):
+def load_user(uid):
     row = db.get("users", uid)
     return User(row)
 
 def fetch_user_cached(uid):

@@ -22,4 +22,4 @@ def profile(request):
     uid = request.args["uid"]
-    user = fetch_user(uid)
+    user = load_user(uid)
     return render(user)
 
@@ -40,4 +40,4 @@ def settings(request):
     uid = session.uid
-    user = fetch_user(uid)
+    user = load_user(uid)
     return render_settings(user)

@@ -14,5 +14,4 @@ def nightly_digest():
     ids = subscriber_ids()
     for uid in ids:
-        # cached: this fans out to every subscriber nightly; stay off the DB
-        user = fetch_user_cached(uid)
+        user = load_user(uid)
         send_digest(user)
